Today Restaurant (《今食堂》)
Today Restaurant
Advisor TENG, SHU-YUAN
Creators Xu Yuan-ping (許瑗玶) · Gao Le-yi (高樂怡) · Chen Shu-kai (陳書凱) · Li Le-rao (黎躒嬈)
Protagonist Bo returns home and learns from his younger brother Ray that the town's abnormal phenomena seem related to a restaurant, whose head chef has coincidentally gone missing. Taking over the restaurant temporarily, he discovers that certain dishes can alleviate residents' abnormal conditions — yet the same power can also be used to manipulate and guide others' will. Monsters affected by "pollution" were originally ordinary creatures or ingredients, serving to the player as either enemies or "processed" food. The story raises questions about faith, responsibility and the boundaries of using power.
